title: Research

Research Project

Weather Forecasting with Fourier Neural Operators
This project investigates the use of Fourier Neural Operators and related deep-learning architectures for spatiotemporal weather forecasting.
Data-generating process. The data are derived from ERA5, a global atmospheric reanalysis dataset produced by the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF). ERA5 combines historical observations from satellites, weather stations, and other instruments with numerical weather prediction models to generate consistent estimates of atmospheric conditions over time.
